obligations.name: provenance_signature
obligations.reason: ECDSA verification of this artifact, not truth or authorization

obligations.name: judgment_signature
obligations.reason: ECDSA verification of this artifact, not truth or authorization

obligations.name: receipt_signature
obligations.reason: ECDSA verification of this artifact, not truth or authorization

obligations.name: inference
obligations.reason: deserialized proof passed native verifier and full output recomputation

obligations.name: provenance_preimage
obligations.reason: exact retained raw bytes and identity transform commitment

obligations.name: input_binding
obligations.reason: claim, provenance, native tensor, judgment and receipt consume identical bytes

obligations.name: model_binding
obligations.reason: pinned model bytes, weights, operator and upstream revision

obligations.name: subject_binding
obligations.reason: declared local subject; no external identity registry claim

obligations.name: proof_binding
obligations.reason: judgment and receipt reference the exact native proof bytes

obligations.name: action_binding
obligations.reason: valid judgment must concern the authorized action

obligations.name: authority
obligations.reason: role-specific keys supplied by the relying party lab policy

obligations.name: execution_binding
obligations.reason: receipt must name the requested execution; identity equality does not prove occurrence

obligations.name: output_binding
obligations.reason: exact recomputed output statement across artifacts

obligations.name: receipt_evidence
obligations.reason: preserved result and observation bytes, not a proof of historical execution

obligations.name: domain
obligations.reason: offline chain domain equality; no RPC or on-chain event is inferred

obligations.name: scope
obligations.reason: only the public MatMul recomputation claim is permitted

obligations.name: policy_binding
obligations.reason: signed policy hash must match the independently selected policy bytes

obligations.name: replay
obligations.reason: caller-provided consumed-nonce snapshot; not durable on-chain replay protection

obligations.name: artifact_types
obligations.reason: laboratory schemas are explicit; no upstream judgment or ReceiptOS conformance claim

obligations.name: claim_strength
obligations.reason: external admission, historical execution, chain origin and task completion lack independent evidence
